title: Any loopback peer is classified as a trusted "LAN" source and receives a credential-free 200 from /auth/verify (Z5 local-process authentication bypass)
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】is_lan_source() 现在有两个前置闸：先要求配置里的 auth_lan_bypass 为真（面板 DEFAULT_CONFIG 写死 False，见 app.py:1036），回环来源还要额外要求 auth_lan_bypass_loopback 为真（auth_gateway.py:1484 读配置时默认 False）。原先那条「addr.is_loopback 直接 return True」的捷径已不存在，所以「任何回环对端都能拿到免凭据 200」这个结论在当前代码上不再成立。
impact: The single gateway password that gates every public_access=true service is bypassable by anything running on the router host. A compromised low-privilege daemon, an unprivileged container sharing the host network namespace, or an SSRF inside any service proxied by the gateway escalates from "one service" to "every service behind the gateway" without ever presenting a credential. The loopback shortcut also means the operator's lan_subnet4/6 tightening provides no protection against local peers.
mitigation: Stop treating "loopback" as "LAN": delete the `addr.is_loopback -> True` shortcut (auth_gateway.py:898-899) so 127.0.0.1 is only exempt if it is explicitly inside a configured lan_subnet4/8 entry — a request from the router itself must still authenticate. Prove the peer is really nginx before trusting proxy headers: have nginx send a per-install random secret header (value in a root-owned 0640 file only nginx and the gateway can read) and reject the request when it is absent/wrong, or move the gateway to a UNIX-domain socket with 0600 permissions and verify SO_PEERCRED. Additionally remove the `from_local = not remote` fallback (:849) so an absent REMOTE_ADDR can never enable header trust, and require a valid token for every request that did not arrive through the authenticated nginx path.
verification: 逐行读过 auth_gateway.py:1470 / 1484 与 app.py:1036 的默认值；同时核对了 app.py:12993（启用网关时显式提醒 lan_bypass）。注意：管理员一旦手动打开 auth_lan_bypass，回环捷径会重新打开——见本轮「本地进程可伪造 X-Real-IP」那条 UNCERTAIN。

title: Gateway LAN matcher accepts a /1 subnet, so half of the IPv4 internet can be granted the credential-free LAN bypass
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】is_lan_source() 的执行点现在写的是 `if net.prefixlen <= 1: continue`，与面板侧 validate_config()（app.py:1923）的钳制规则完全一致，/0 与 /1 都会被忽略、当作「没有可用网段」继续走向 fail-closed。原先「执行点只挡 /0、控制点挡 <=1，两层不一致」的缺口已补上。
impact: With lan_subnet4/lan_subnet6 set to a /1, every unauthenticated request from half of the IPv4 internet (or half of IPv6) is classified as LAN by the gateway: /auth/verify answers 200, nginx proxies the protected service, and the operator's password stops being required for that whole range. This is the same catastrophic outcome the /0 guard was added to prevent, but the enforcement point still lets it through, and the value that triggers it is rejected by the very validation the project wrote for it (app.py:1435), so the two layers disagree about what is acceptable.
mitigation: Make the enforcement point enforce the same rule as the control point: in is_lan_source(), reject any configured network whose prefixlen is <= 1 (not just == 0) exactly as validate_config does at app.py:1435 — e.g. `if net.prefixlen <= 1: continue` — and treat such a configuration as "no usable subnet" so the function falls through to its fail-closed `return False` (:927). Apply the same clamp to lan_cidr/_safe_cidr in app.py so the generated nginx `allow` list can never be wider than /2 either. Ideally share one helper between app.py and auth_gateway.py so the two layers cannot drift again.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1500-1503（注释里明确写着「面板侧早就是 prefixlen <= 1」）；核对 app.py:1923 与 app.py:1861 两处控制点钳制，三处规则一致。

title: /auth/status omits the token epoch check — a pre-password-change token is still reported as an authenticated session, trapping the browser in a login↔portal redirect loop
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】auth_status() 现在在 :1694 调用 _payload_epoch_ok(payload, cfg)，与 _verify_or_deny()（:1989）、_authenticated()（:2139）走同一套 epoch 判据。改密码抬高的 auth_token_epoch 同样会作废 /auth/status 里的旧令牌，原先「改密码后旧令牌仍被报成已登录」的问题已修。
impact: A credential that the gateway has already invalidated (password change / epoch bump) is still reported as an active session, disclosing the account name, device id, browser fingerprint and remaining TTL to anyone holding it, and contradicting the two authoritative consumers. More seriously, the login page trusts that same answer, so a browser holding a stale token is bounced between /auth/login and / without ever being shown the password form: after a routine password change the administrator is locked out of the remote gateway until the cookie is manually deleted.
mitigation: Apply the missing checks in `auth_status()`: reject the token with `_payload_epoch_ok(payload, cfg)` and the absolute-TTL deadline (`now - payload['iat'] > _absolute_ttl(cfg)`) exactly as `_verify_or_deny()` does, and extract the token with the shared `_extract_token()` helper. Better: factor the whole predicate (signature + exp + epoch + revocation + absolute TTL) into one function used by all four consumers so the check sets cannot drift again.
verification: grep _payload_epoch_ok 命中 4 处（定义在 :2087，三条鉴权路径各调一次），确认判据共用。

title: auth_login revokes only the cookie-borne previous token — a Bearer client's old credential survives re-authentication (session-fixation style token reuse)
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】登录路径现在用 `_old = parse_token(_extract_token())`（:1887），与 logout 走同一个提取函数（Bearer 优先、cookie 兜底）。原先「只吊销 cookie 里的旧令牌、Bearer 客户端的旧凭据在重新登录后依然有效」这个不对称已经消除。:1880 的注释还专门记录了 2026-10-16 修过同类不对称。
impact: A stolen Bearer token keeps authenticating successfully after the legitimate user re-logs in — the user believes the re-login revoked the old credential, but only the browser cookie was revoked. Because the surviving token can itself be slid-renewed by the attacker, the exposed credential can remain usable for up to the absolute lifetime.
mitigation: Use `_extract_token()` (Bearer-first) in `auth_login` instead of reading the cookie directly, and revoke the presented token — ideally both the Bearer token and the cookie token when they differ — before issuing the replacement.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1875-1895 全文；确认 _extract_token 的 Bearer 优先语义（:1910-1936）与 logout（:1941）一致。

title: Login rate-limit table has no cap on tracked IPs and is fully rewritten (json.load + truncate + dump + fsync) on every login attempt → unbounded memory/disk growth and O(n²) write amplification
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】限流表现在有 IP 数上限：RATELIMIT_MAX_IPS 默认 10000（:104），超出后按最久未活跃淘汰。原先「跟踪的 IP 数无上限、每次登录尝试都整表重写」导致的内存与 IO 放大已被封住。
impact: Unauthenticated resource exhaustion on a ~1 GiB router: the rate-limit file grows without bound (flash exhaustion / tmpfs RAM exhaustion), and every login attempt becomes O(N) in memory and disk I/O, so the login path degrades to a stall and the whole public edge (nginx auth_request → this process) slows down or dies. Consequence: denial of service, plus loss of the brute-force counter state (see the corruption finding) which re-enables password guessing.
mitigation: Cap the number of tracked IPs exactly like `_STATUS_HITS` does (e.g. keep at most N=512/4096 entries, evicting the oldest, and refuse to insert new keys once the cap is reached — the current behaviour under a full table must be fail-closed for the *new* key only, not for existing locked keys). Additionally avoid rewriting the whole table on every request (e.g. per-IP sharded files, or an append-only log with periodic compaction), and bound the maximum file size with an explicit check before `json.dump`.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:104 的常量与 :806 的淘汰分支。

title: Degraded-mode in-memory rate-limit fallback `_RATE_FALLBACK` is unbounded and never pruned — one permanent dict entry per distinct source IP
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】降级态的内存兜底 _RATE_FALLBACK 现在有 RATE_FALLBACK_MAX_IPS=4096（:108）和两条剪枝路径（:806 过期清理、:815-816 超量淘汰最久未活跃项）。原先「每个不同来源 IP 永久占一个 dict 条目、永不清理」的放大面已封。
impact: In degraded mode (the table missing or unwritable — exactly the condition the init script's own comments document as a real .224 production incident) an unauthenticated attacker can grow the gateway's heap without bound by rotating source IPs, OOM-killing the only process that nginx's auth_request depends on. The whole public edge then returns 502. A gateway restart in the degraded state additionally resets the brute-force counters, re-enabling unlimited password guessing in 5-attempt batches.
mitigation: Bound `_RATE_FALLBACK` exactly like `_STATUS_HITS`: cap the number of tracked IPs (e.g. 512) and sweep entries whose `locked_until`/`fails` are older than RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW on every insert (do it under a lock — `_RATE_FALLBACK` is currently mutated from multiple WSGI threads without any lock). Persist the fallback counters to a side file if cross-restart durability in degraded mode is required.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:94-108 的常量定义与 :790-820 的剪枝实现。

title: Rate-limit table is rewritten in place (truncate+write) and read without the shared lock, so a corrupt/torn table silently wipes every lockout and downgrades the verdict to "not locked" (brute force possible)
description:
【2026-11-20 复核：已修】**只修了一半。** 已修的部分：读端 _is_locked() 现在用 fcntl.flock(LOCK_SH)（:2193），读到的是完整的旧内容或完整的新内容，不会再读到 truncate 与 json.dump 之间的半截 JSON；except 子句也从 OSError/JSONDecodeError 扩到 `except (OSError, ValueError)`（:2203），非法 UTF-8（UnicodeDecodeError 是 ValueError 子类）不再炸出来。
**仍在的部分**：写路径 _mutate_ratelimit() 仍是 truncate + 就地写（:882-891），且 json 解析失败时 `data = {}`（:890-891）——损坏的表会让**全部计数器被清空**，这就是 fail-open。这一半单独列为本轮的 CONFIRMED 条目。
impact: Brute force possible: when the rate-limit file is corrupt or momentarily torn, the lockout verdict is downgraded to "not locked" for every IP and the accumulated failure counters are discarded, so an attacker under lockout regains a full budget of 5 attempts per window, and the 900 s lockout no longer protects the single shared edge password.
mitigation: Make the rewrite atomic: write the new table to `path + ".tmp"` in the same directory, `fsync` it, then `os.replace(tmp, path)` (the flock then protects the tmp/inode pair rather than the live file), exactly as the panel does in app.py:220-231. Make the readers take a shared `LOCK_SH` (or read the file once into memory under the writer's lock) so a torn state is never observed. On a parse failure, do not silently substitute an empty table: keep the previous good snapshot (last-known-good) the way the revocation store does at backend/auth_gateway.py:465-474, so a corrupt file does not wipe existing lockouts.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:868-905（写路径）与 :2170-2210（读路径），两处 except 与 flock 逐行确认。

title: Revocation last-known-good snapshot is never refreshed on write, so a logout revocation is silently lost (logged-out token becomes valid again) when the revocation file becomes unreadable or torn
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】吊销表的 last-known-good 快照现在在写入路径上刷新：_REVOKED_LKG = data（:600）与 _REVOKED_LKG = dict(data)（:696）两处都会用最新内容覆盖快照。原先「登出写了吊销表但快照不刷新、读失败时回退到旧快照 ⇒ 登出的令牌又活了」这个路径已堵。
impact: Session termination is not reliably effective: after a logout that returned HTTP 200, the token can be accepted again if the revocation table is deleted, corrupted or torn, which is the exact incident the code's own comments cite from the .224 deployment. A stolen token therefore survives the victim's logout, and with the sliding renewal plus the 12 h absolute TTL it can stay usable. Conversely, a torn read in a freshly started process revokes every token at once (total authentication outage).
mitigation: Refresh `_REVOKED_LKG` inside `revoke_jti` immediately after the successful `fsync` (set it to the exact dict that was written), so the last-known-good snapshot always contains the newest revocation. Write the revocation table atomically (temp file + `os.replace`) and read it under a shared lock so no reader can observe a torn file. Consider recording the revocation in the LKG before the fsync so that even a failed write cannot leave the in-memory state behind the disk state.
verification: grep _REVOKED_LKG 全部命中点（:561 定义、:591/:597 初始化、:600 写后刷新、:696 写后刷新），确认写路径都覆盖了快照。

title: Init script only re-seeds the security tables when they are missing or 0 bytes; a non-empty but invalid-JSON table is left in place, so the revocation table stays corrupt across restarts (all users locked out) and the rate-limit table stays corrupt (all lockouts lost)
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】init 脚本在遍历安全表（限流表、吊销表）时，除了「不存在或 0 字节」以外，还检查了内容是否是合法 JSON（:196-199 的注释点明「空文件不是合法 JSON」），非空但内容损坏的表会被重新播种，不会被原样留下。
impact: All users locked out (revocation table corrupt → every token judged revoked → the portal never accepts a session) with no automatic repair across restarts, or brute force possible (rate-limit table corrupt → every lockout wiped and the lockout verdict downgraded to "not locked"). The two tables are the gateway's only persistent security state, and the init script — the component responsible for guaranteeing they are well-formed — only guarantees emptiness, not validity.
mitigation: Validate the seeded tables instead of only their size: if the file is missing, empty, or does not parse as a JSON object, replace it with `{}` (e.g. `printf '{}' > file.tmp && mv file.tmp file`, keeping the 0600 mode and the nftweb owner) so a corrupt table is repaired at every service start. The same repair should be done by the gateway itself on startup (a corrupt revocation table should be re-seeded as `{}` with an audit record) rather than leaving the service permanently fail-closed. Make the gateway's write path atomic (temp file + `os.replace`) so corruption is not produced in the first place.
verification: 读 backend/nftables-web-auth.init:190-240 的播种循环与注释。

title: Audit log file mode regresses to 0644 (world-readable) after the first rotation, discarding the 0640 nftweb:nftweb permission the init script enforces at startup
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】审计日志现在有固定模式常量 AUDIT_LOG_MODE = 0o640（:71），两条写路径都用 `os.open(path, ..., AUDIT_LOG_MODE)` 创建（:1189、:1270），不依赖 umask。轮转函数 _audit_rotate_in_place() 是**原地截断**（:1169 的 open(path, "w") 作用在已存在的文件上，不会重建），因此轮转后模式仍是 0640，不会像原先那样退化成 0644 变成全机可读。
impact: After the first log rotation the authentication audit trail becomes world-readable on the device (any local account or service on the router can read the source IPs, device fingerprints and URIs of all authentication attempts), weakening the confidentiality of the security log that the init script explicitly restricts to root:nftweb 0640.
mitigation: After the rotation, re-create the log with the intended ownership and mode — e.g. `os.open(AUDIT_LOG, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_APPEND, 0o640)` and an explicit `os.chmod(AUDIT_LOG, 0o640)` after `os.replace`, or simply `os.chmod(path, 0o640)` right after the rotation. Alternatively rotate into a directory the gateway owns and let the init script's mode be re-applied by a wrapper.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:62-71 的常量、:1186-1200 与 :1267-1275 的两处写路径、:1138-1175 的轮转函数，逐行确认没有 unlink+recreate。

title: `_is_locked` only catches OSError/JSONDecodeError, so a rate-limit table containing invalid UTF-8 raises an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError and turns every login into HTTP 500 (the "one broken table locks everybody out" regression)
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】_is_locked() 的 except 已是 `except (OSError, ValueError)`（:2203），UnicodeDecodeError 是 ValueError 的子类，会被这一条覆盖，不再抛出未捕获异常。原先「表里存了非法 UTF-8 就直接把登录打成 500」已修。
impact: A rate-limit table that contains non-UTF-8 bytes makes every login request return HTTP 500 — all users are locked out of the authentication endpoint with no lockout policy involved and no self-healing path, since the file stays invalid until it is rewritten by a successful `_mutate_ratelimit` write (which cannot happen because the exception is raised before the write).
mitigation: Widen the exception set to `except (OSError, ValueError)` (covering `JSONDecodeError` and `UnicodeDecodeError`) at backend/auth_gateway.py:1443, exactly as `load_revoked` already does at backend/auth_gateway.py:469 — or catch `Exception` and treat any unreadable table as "no lockout information" (fail-open for the limiter) rather than letting it escape into the request handler. Apply the same treatment to any other `json.load` of an on-disk state file.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:2193-2210 的完整 except 链与注释（注释里写明「ValueError 覆盖 json.JSONDecodeError」）。

title: Revocation map has no size cap and every authenticated request re-reads and re-parses the whole file, so an authenticated client can inflate the jti→exp table into a per-request memory/disk amplification
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】吊销表现在有 REVOKED_MAX_ENTRIES = 10000（:105）的上限。原先「已认证客户端可以无限撑大吊销表、而每个认证请求都要整表重读重解析」这个放大面已封。
impact: An authenticated client (a stolen or shared session, or a looping script) can inflate the revocation table without limit; the file grows until the flash/RAM is exhausted, and every authenticated request of every user then pays a full re-parse of the table, which degrades the gateway to the point where nginx auth_request times out and the entire public edge goes down.
mitigation: Cap the number of revocation entries (e.g. keep at most N most-recent entries and refuse/evict beyond that, or store a per-session revocation list instead of a global map). Cache the parsed table by mtime (as `load_gateway_config` does) so that the per-request check does not re-read and re-parse the file, and refresh it only when the mtime changes or after a write. Write the table atomically (temp file + `os.replace`) to avoid the torn-read window, and consider shortening the retention of revoked jtis to the sliding TTL rather than the absolute TTL.
verification: grep REVOKED_MAX_ENTRIES 命中定义行 :105。

title: Re-login token revocation reads only the gw_token cookie instead of _extract_token(), so a previously issued Bearer token is never revoked
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】与「auth_login revokes only the cookie-borne previous token」同源：重新登录时用 _extract_token() 取旧凭据（:1887），Bearer 令牌也会被吊销。
impact: A previously issued token that is presented as a Bearer credential (not stored in the gw_token cookie) is not invalidated when the client logs in again, so a leaked/stolen token stays valid until its own expiry and keeps working after the legitimate re-authentication - defeating the session-invalidation-on-re-login control for exactly the client class the repository flagged as the affected one.
mitigation: Use the same credential accessor everywhere: replace the direct cookie read at :1154 with `_extract_token()` (as `auth_logout` at :1207 and `_verify_or_deny`/`_authenticated` already do), so the token actually presented by the client - Bearer or cookie - is the one that gets revoked on re-login. Add a regression test that logs in with a Bearer token, re-logs in, and asserts the old token is rejected.
verification: 同上，读 auth_gateway.py:1887。

title: Login CSRF origin check compares host names only and is anchored on the client-supplied Host header
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】CSRF 判定的锚点已经**从客户端提供的 Host 头换成服务端自己知道的域名集合**：_origin_host_mismatch() 依赖 _trusted_host_names(cfg)（:2215 起），该集合全部来自落盘配置（base_domain / cookie_domain / 反代规则的 host），认证服务只读不猜。原先「锚在客户端可控的 Host 头上 ⇒ 攻击者可以把自己的域名塞进 Host 让检查通过」这个路径已堵。
mitigation: Do not derive the expected origin from the request. Build a canonical origin from server-side configuration (the gateway's own hostname/port, e.g. the configured base_domain / gateway_port, or an explicit allowlist of origins) and compare the full tuple: parse the Origin with urlparse and require `scheme.lower()`, `hostname.lower()` and an effective `port` (default 443/80 by scheme) to equal the canonical values. Compare the Origin's port against the *canonical* port instead of dropping it, and compare the scheme as well, so `http://host` and `https://host:otherport` are rejected. Additionally validate the Host header itself (reject requests whose Host is not in the set of server_names the gateway is configured for) so request.host cannot be chosen by the client, and treat a missing/unparsable Origin or Referer as cross-site for cookie-bearing flows.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1790-1797 的调用点与 :2215 起 _trusted_host_names 的docstring（写明来源全部是落盘配置）。

title: auth_status() reads the token straight from the cookie instead of _extract_token() — Bearer clients are told they are unauthenticated, and the same request can be judged differently by different consumers
description: **仍在。** auth_status() 在 :1672 用 `parse_token(request.cookies.get(COOKIE_TOKEN, ""))` 直接读 cookie，没有走 _extract_token()（:1936，Bearer 优先、cookie 兜底）。⇒ 只带 Authorization: Bearer 的客户端调 /auth/status 会被判成未认证，拿不到滑动续期的新令牌，只能靠 cookie 走。影响面比基线描述的小（它只是让 Bearer 客户端用不了续期，不构成越权），但机制确实原样存在。
impact: Bearer-authenticated clients are reported as unauthenticated by /auth/status even though their token is accepted everywhere else, and when a request carries both a cookie and a Bearer token the status endpoint and the authorisation path can disagree about whether the session is valid.
mitigation: Replace the direct cookie read at backend/auth_gateway.py:1048 with `_extract_token()` so that all four consumers resolve the credential the same way.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1665-1700（auth_status 主体）与 :1910-1937（_extract_token 的 Bearer 优先语义），对比确认 :1672 未走该函数。

title: The gateway login rate-limit table is wiped wholesale when its JSON is unreadable, so a corrupted table silently re-opens brute-force protection
description:
限流表的**写**路径在 JSON 解析失败时会把整张表清空：_mutate_ratelimit() 在 :868 定义，:887 `data = json.load(f)` 抛 JSONDecodeError/ValueError 时，:890-891 直接 `data = {}`，随后把这份空表写回文件。⇒ 一旦表损坏，该文件里**所有** IP 的失败计数与锁定状态一起消失，暴力破解防护当场回到零。
触发路径有两条，都不需要攻击者有特权：一是写端本身是 truncate + 就地写（:882 用 "r+" 打开后 f.truncate() 再 json.dump），**不是原子替换**，设备掉电/进程被杀就会留下半截 JSON；二是文件被外部改动（表属 nftweb:nftweb 0600，一般只有 root 或网关自己能碰）。
读端已经修过一半（:2193 用 LOCK_SH 避免撕裂读），但写端这个「损坏即清空」的动作还在：下一次有 IP 来尝试登录，就会把损坏的表覆盖成空表，并把该 IP 自己的计数也一并丢掉。
impact: 限流是防止口令爆破的唯一屏障。表一旦损坏，全部来源的失败计数与锁定同时归零，攻击者可以用一个此前已被锁定的来源继续尝试口令而不再触发 429。由于写端非原子，这个状态可以由一次意外断电产生，不需要任何人刻意为之。
mitigation: 写端改成「临时文件 + os.replace 原子替换」，与面板侧 _ratelimit_write() （app.py:364 起，已有 tmp + 原子替换）保持一致；解析失败时**保留原表**并直接返回（宁可沿用旧的锁定状态，也不把计数清零），而不是 data = {}。另外给写端加一次 fsync + 目录 fsync，避免掉电留下半截文件。
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:868-905 的完整写路径（os.fdopen("r+") → flock → seek(0) → json.load → except → data = {} → truncate → dump），逐行确认「解析失败即清空」这条分支；并与 app.py:364 的面板侧原子写实现对比，确认两侧行为不一致。

title: The panel login-failure rate-limit table fails open when the file is corrupt or unreadable
description:
面板侧的限流表读取 _ratelimit_read()（app.py:354）在 :360 捕获 (FileNotFoundError, JSONDecodeError, ValueError, OSError) 后 :361 直接 `return {}`，把「读不到」和「表是空的」当成同一件事处理 ⇒ 文件损坏时所有来源的失败计数与锁定一起消失（fail-open）。
与网关侧不同的是，面板侧的**写**路径是 tmp 文件 + os.replace 原子替换（:364 的 _ratelimit_write），所以文件因崩溃而损坏的概率低得多；这条主要是「损坏即静默失效」这个设计取向，以及与网关侧同一问题的不一致。
impact: 面板口令的失败计数一旦因文件损坏而清零，暴力破解面板口令的窗口重新打开，且没有任何告警（异常被吞掉，不写日志）。
mitigation: 读失败时区分「文件不存在（首次启动，正常）」与「文件存在但读不出来（异常）」：后者应保留原文件、记一条审计、并 fail-closed（按已锁定处理）或至少告警，而不是当成空表。
verification: 读 app.py:354-375 的读写两个函数；确认 except 分支后紧跟 `return {}`，且读路径没有任何告警或审计输出。

title: On the LAN-bypass branch the gateway forwards the raw, unvalidated gw_device cookie to upstream services as X-Auth-Device
description:
_verify_or_deny() 在 LAN bypass 分支上，:1975 把 `request.cookies.get(COOKIE_DEVICE, "")` **原样**放进 X-Auth-Device 响应头；而令牌分支 :2005 用的是签名载荷里的 dev（`str(payload.get("dev",""))[:64]`）。⇒ 同一个响应头在两条路径上的可信度完全不同：LAN 分支的值是客户端自己填的，没有任何校验（device_id_from_request() 只在令牌分支做字符集收敛）。
这个头会继续被 nginx 转发给上游业务：app.py:11741 写 `proxy_set_header X-Auth-Device $auth_device;`，$auth_device 在公网分支取自认证服务回的头（:11749）、在内网分支取自 $cookie_gw_device（:11765）。⇒ 上游服务拿到的「设备标识」在公网路径下是客户端自称的，在内网路径下是 cookie 原值——两个口径都不是服务端证明的。
impact: 上游服务若把 X-Auth-Device 当作可信身份做审计、限流或去重，攻击者可以任意伪造设备标识，污染上游的审计记录或绕过按设备的限流。影响有限的原因：需要管理员显式打开 auth_lan_bypass（默认关闭），且上游必须自己选择信任这个头。
mitigation: LAN bypass 分支也走一次 device_id_from_request() 的字符集与长度收敛，不要把 cookie 原值直接透传；同时在文档里写明 X-Auth-Device 是「客户端自称的标识，服务端未经验证」，让上游不要把它当作可信身份。
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1965-2010 的两个分支，对比 :1975 与 :2005；读 app.py:11738-11770 的 nginx 生成代码，确认两条分支的 $auth_device 来源。

title: The gateway login CSRF check is skipped entirely when both Origin and Referer are absent
description: POST /auth/login 的来源检查有三层：origin == "null" 拒绝；origin 非空且 _origin_host_mismatch(origin) 拒绝（:1790）；origin 为空但 referer 非空且 host 不匹配则拒绝（:1794）。**当 origin 与 referer 都为空时，三层都不触发**，直接走到 :1799 的取 IP 与口令校验。⇒ 该端点在「无来源头」时没有任何 CSRF 屏障。
impact: 实际可利用性有限：现代浏览器对所有 POST 都会带 Origin（跨站时为对方源、sandboxed iframe 为 null 而被拒），Referer 即使被策略剥离，Origin 仍在，所以「两个头都没有」只可能出现在非浏览器客户端上——而那些客户端本来就能自己带任意头，CSRF 对它们不成立。真正的残余风险是纵深防御缺失：这个端点的防护依赖浏览器的一个行为约定，而不是服务端自己的检查。
mitigation: 在 origin 与 referer 都为空时按「拒绝」处理（返回 403），或者引入一个双提交 CSRF token，让防护不依赖浏览器是否发送 Origin。
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1770-1805 的来源检查块，确认三个分支的短路条件；并读 :2215 起 _trusted_host_names，确认 host 判定用的是服务端配置而非请求头。

title: Insecure default auth_lan_bypass=True is merged into every config and persisted to the live policy file, defeating the gateway's fail-closed fallback and exempting the whole LAN from authentication
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】面板 DEFAULT_CONFIG 现在写的是 "auth_lan_bypass": False（app.py:1036），不是原先的 True；读取时也用 config.get("auth_lan_bypass", False) 兜底（app.py:12893、auth_gateway.py:1470）。⇒ 新装设备默认**不**开 LAN 免认证，「默认值被合并进配置并持久化到线上策略文件」这个高危默认已修。
impact: Complete authentication bypass for the whole LAN subnet against all publicly exposed services on the public edge: a guest device, a compromised IoT box or any other host inside `lan_subnet4` reaches every `public_access=true` reverse-proxy service without a password, and there is no session that could be revoked. The bypass is materialised on disk by ordinary panel use, not by an explicit opt-in.
mitigation: Default `auth_lan_bypass` to False (fail-closed) in DEFAULT_CONFIG, and stop letting the DEFAULT_CONFIG merge silently materialise security-relevant defaults into the persisted policy — either omit keys whose absence must mean "deny" from the merge, or write an explicit, audited opt-in record when the operator enables the bypass. Additionally, make the gateway require an explicit, authenticated opt-in (e.g. a separate root-owned flag file) rather than honouring a plain boolean in the user-writable JSON, so a hand-edited or default-merged file cannot switch it on.
verification: grep auth_lan_bypass 全部命中点，确认默认值在三处都是 False；并核对 app.py:12993（启用网关时对 lan_bypass 的额外提醒）。

title: Panel session-signing key is the shared master secret, readable by the de-privileged WAN-facing gateway, enabling forged admin sessions
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】面板会话密钥与网关令牌密钥已经是**两个不同的文件**：会话密钥 /etc/nftables/nftables-web-session-secret 是 0600 root:root（init 脚本 :171-174 生成时就是 0600），网关令牌密钥是 0640 root:nftweb。认证服务以 uid nftweb 运行且 initgroups() 清掉了附加组 ⇒ 它能读令牌密钥，但**读不到**会话密钥。⇒ 「降权的公网进程能读面板主密钥、从而伪造管理员会话」这个路径已堵。（面板自己以 root 运行能读两者，但面板本来就是 root，那不是提权。）
impact: Any compromise of the de-privileged, internet-facing authentication gateway (or of any other process running as the nftweb user) is immediately a root compromise of the router: the attacker forges a panel session cookie and gains the panel's full root capabilities (nftables ruleset rewrite, uci, crontab, nginx configuration, TLS private keys). The privilege drop introduced specifically to contain such a compromise provides no containment at all.
mitigation: Do not use the shared master secret as the panel's session-signing key. Give the panel its own session key in a separate file that the gateway never needs to read (e.g. /etc/nftables/nftables-web-session-key, mode 0600 root:root), and let the gateway keep deriving its token key from the shared secret exactly as it does today (_token_key()), so the two processes hold unrelated keys. Failing that, store a derived panel key (HMAC(secret, "nftables-web/panel-session/v1")) in a root-only file. Audit every other consumer of AUTH_SECRET_FILE for the same reuse.
verification: 读 backend/nftables-web-auth.init:159-180（两个密钥各自的生成与权限）与app.py:145-160（_init_app_secret 读不到就重写随机值）；并确认认证服务的 uid 与附加组。

title: Open redirect in gateway login page: safeNext() bypassed by tab/newline in ?next= enables post-authentication redirect to an attacker-controlled origin
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】登录页的 safeNext() 现在有三道闸：:134 用 `/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/` 把所有控制字符（含 tab 0x09、换行 0x0a）整个判掉；:135 要求首字符必须是 "/"（拦掉 "//evil.com" 这类协议相对 URL）；:136 要求第二个字符不是 "/"。⇒ 基线说的「用 tab/换行绕过 safeNext() 做登录后开放重定向」已经被控制字符正则堵住。
impact: Post-authentication open redirect on the authentication gateway itself. The victim is on the genuine gateway origin (the address bar shows the real host, the CSP/nosniff/no-store headers are all genuine) and is bounced to attacker-controlled content either immediately after entering the correct gateway password (login.js:112) or straight away if she already has a session (login.js:181). Because the gateway's whole purpose is to front several internal services, the redirect can land the user on an attacker-made copy of a legitimate service (e.g. a Siyuan/Firefox/DSM UI) that asks for a "session expired, please sign in again" — the credential is then captured by the attacker, not the gateway. This also degrades the gateway's anti-phishing posture: users learn to trust that any `https://<gw>/auth/login?next=…` link is legitimate because it really is the real gateway serving the real page.
verification: 读 backend/static/login.js:130-140 的 safeNext() 全文，逐条确认三个return "/" 的短路条件与其正则。

title: Rate-limit mutation reports fail_count 0 immediately after arming the lockout, so the login error body tells the client "remaining: 5" on the very failure that locked it out
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】_mutate_ratelimit() 在触发锁定时**保留** fails 列表（不再清空），所以返回的 fail_count 等于上限值、remaining 算出来是 0，而不是原先的 0。源码 :906 的注释把这件事写明了（:913 写着「改成保留 fails（长度 = MAX）→ remaining = 0」）。⇒ 错误响应体里「还剩几次」不再骗人。
impact: Minor information disclosure of the exact limiter state and a misleading client-visible counter: the response claims five attempts remain on the failure that actually locked the source IP out, so the lockout state is observable one request early and client-side retry logic is misled. No authentication decision is affected (the 429 verdict itself is computed correctly from `locked_until`).
mitigation: Return the true post-mutation state from `_mutate_ratelimit`/`_ratelimit_fallback_mutate`: return `locked=True` and a fail count of `RATE_LIMIT_MAX_FAILS` (or a separate `locked_until` value) when the lockout is armed, and have `auth_login` report `remaining: 0` plus a distinct `RATE_LIMITED` code for that request instead of `AUTH_FAILED` with `remaining: 5`.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:900-920 的触发锁定分支与其注释。

title: Unhandled exception in the certificate auto-renewal loop aborts renewal of every remaining certificate
description: 【2026-11-20 复核：已修】_renew_due_certs() 现在是**每张证书单独 try/except**（:12670 的注释写明「每张证书单独 try/except（P1-40）」），单张证书失败只 continue，不会中断后面所有证书的续期。⇒ 基线说的「一张证书抛异常、后面全部不再续期」已修。
impact: A single malformed certificate entry permanently disables automatic renewal for every certificate that follows it in the list. The gateway then keeps serving TLS certificates that silently expire (no panel error, only a traceback in /var/log/nftables-web-cert-renew.log), so the public authentication gateway degrades to expired-certificate warnings/failures for all users of the affected domains, and any auto-issued certificate in the list is never refreshed.
mitigation: Make the renewal loop fault-tolerant: wrap the per-certificate body in `try/except Exception` and convert failures into an entry in the `errors` list (which the CLI already prints and turns into a non-zero exit code) instead of letting the exception escape. Validate the domain defensively before calling `_acme_renew()` (skip and report entries whose domain fails `_sanitize_domain()`), and skip/report non-dict entries in `reverse_proxy.certificates` rather than calling `.get()` on them. A per-entry `try/except` guarantees that one bad record can never block the renewal of the rest.
verification: 读 backend/app.py:12663-12700 的循环体，确认每个分支都被 try 包住且失败路径是 continue。

title: Shared secrets (Flask SECRET_KEY, Aliyun AK/SK) are created world-readable and only chmod'ed afterwards
description:
面板会话密钥的创建仍然不是原子的：app.py:157 用 `open(path, "w")` 建立文件（按当前 umask，通常是 0644），:158 才调 _apply_session_secret_perms() 把它收紧到 0600 root:root。⇒ 从建文件到 chmod 完成之间存在一个极短的窗口，文件对「其它」可读。
与基线描述的差别要说清楚：基线写的是「先以 world-readable 建立、之后才 chmod」，现在**仍然**是这个顺序，只是窗口从「长期存在」缩到了「毫秒级」；且只发生在**首次创建**时（文件已存在就直接读回，init 脚本那边生成时就是 0600）。触发还需要设备上有别的本地用户正好在那个瞬间读该文件。
impact: 面板会话密钥泄露 ⇒ 攻击者可以伪造任意管理员会话。由于窗口极小、且要求本地已有一个能读文件系统的用户，实际可利用性很低，属于纵深防御缺口而不是可直接利用的漏洞。
mitigation: 改成 `fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)` 一次性以 0600 建出来，再写内容——这样文件从存在的第一刻起就是 0600，不存在窗口。审计日志那边已经是这个写法（auth_gateway.py:1189、:1270 用 os.open + AUDIT_LOG_MODE），照抄即可。
verification: 读 backend/app.py:145-165 的 _init_app_secret 全文，确认创建与 chmod 是两个独立步骤；并与 auth_gateway.py:1189 的 os.open(mode) 写法对比。

title: Gateway privilege drop fails open and silently: AUTH_DROP_UID unset leaves the public auth process running as root
description:
认证服务的降权检查是条件式的：initgroups() 清附加组这一步在 AUTH_DROP_UID 为空时整体跳过（auth_gateway.py:2589 读不到 uid 就直接返回 False），而调用方不检查这个返回值。⇒ 如果 AUTH_DROP_UID 没被设置，公网可达的认证进程会**继续以 root 运行**，而且没有报错。
缓解事实：init 脚本总是设置 AUTH_DROP_UID="$NFTWEB_UID"，且脚本里另有一段检查「进程 uid 仍是 0 就杀掉」。所以现网部署不会踩到；风险在于任何绕过 init 脚本直接起这个进程的路径（手工 nohup python3 auth_gateway.py、容器里直接跑）会静默地以 root 运行。
impact: 认证网关是唯一对公网可达的应用进程。它以 root 运行时，任何一个解析/注入类缺陷都会被放大成路由器 root 权限。当前所有已知注入点都已评估为「需要管理员会话」，所以这不是可直接利用的漏洞，但它是这些防护失守后的放大器。
mitigation: 把降权失败从「警告」升级为「拒绝启动」：_drop_privileges() 返回 False 时直接退出并打印明确原因；init 脚本已有一致的先例（uid 仍是 0 就杀进程）。另外在 auth_gateway.py 入口加一条断言：uid == 0 时直接拒绝启动。
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:2580-2600 的 _drop_privileges() 实现与调用点；读 backend/nftables-web-auth.init 的降权段（:359 起）确认 init 路径确实总会设置 AUTH_DROP_UID 并有 uid 兜底检查。

title: Sliding renewal revokes the presented jti but delivers the replacement only through a Set-Cookie that nginx's auth_request discards — the client's sole credential is destroyed and never replaced
description:
【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】这条的前提在当前代码上不成立，而且续期路径本身已经收口。
（一）前提不成立：滑动续期发生在 auth_status() 里，而 /auth/status 是**客户端直接访问**的端点（nginx 的 `location = /auth/status`），不是通过 `auth_request` 子请求调用的。nginx 丢弃子请求响应头里的 Set-Cookie，只影响 `auth_request` 的目标（/_auth，即 verify），不影响客户端直接访问 auth_status 时 Set-Cookie 的下发。
（二）已收口：吊销旧 jti 失败时不再「当成成功」—— :1749 检查返回值并落审计 `refresh_old_token_not_revoked`，:1759 的 _mark_superseded() 把旧 jti 放进进程内的「已被取代」名单，is_revoked() 一并查它 ⇒ 旧令牌在本进程内立即失效。:1764 的 _set_cookies() 照常把新令牌下发，浏览器不会因此被踢下线。
impact: The sliding-renewal mechanism, which is the only thing keeping long-lived sessions alive and the only thing that kills a stolen copy of a token when the victim keeps using the session, is inoperative in the deployed topology: the server revokes the client's only credential while the replacement is discarded by nginx. Every remote session is terminated at the first renewal (~15 minutes after login) and Bearer clients are locked out permanently.
mitigation: Propagate the renewed token to the client (nginx `auth_request_set`/`add_header` for `Set-Cookie`, or an `X-Auth-Token` response header that the client echoes back as a Bearer credential), and only revoke the previous `jti` once the replacement has actually been delivered; for Bearer clients return the new token in the response body/header rather than only as a cookie.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:1735-1765 的续期段全文；核对 :1759 的 _mark_superseded 调用与 :1764 的 _set_cookies；对照 app.py:11749 确认 auth_request 的目标是 /_auth 而非 /auth/status。

title: Client-supplied Host header trusted for the login redirect, for upstream requests and for rewritten Location headers
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】全部改成用 nginx 规范化过的 $host，不再用客户端可控的 $http_host：:11646/:11650 的登录跳转用配置里的端口而不是 $http_host（注释写明「后者是客户端可控的 Host 头」）；:11692 的 X-Forwarded-Host 用 $host + 服务端端口（P2-19）；:11731 的 proxy_set_header Host 用 $host:$server_port；:11950 的 proxy_redirect 也不用 $http_host。
impact: A client that controls the `Host` header of a request to the gateway can make the gateway emit a redirect to an arbitrary host (`Location: https://<attacker-host>:<port>/auth/login?...`), and can make the proxied application believe it is serving the attacker-controlled host, which commonly results in absolute redirects or links pointing at the attacker's domain while the user believes they are on the gateway's trusted, certificate-validated origin. This is the classic Host-header injection / open-redirect pattern, useful for phishing and for poisoning password-reset or callback links generated by the upstream application.
mitigation: Do not derive the redirect target from the request. Pin the canonical host: store the configured public host (the certificate's base domain / `reverse_proxy.settings.base_domain`) and emit it literally in the `return 302` and in the `proxy_redirect` replacement instead of `$host`; or validate the incoming `Host` against the set of configured `server_name` values (e.g. with a `map $host $canonical_host` that falls back to the configured host) and use the canonical value. For the upstream request, forward a trusted host (`proxy_set_header Host $upstream_host;` or the configured host) in path mode, and keep `$http_host` only where the host-dispatch semantics genuinely require it. In all cases make sure the generated `proxy_redirect` rules also cover absolute `Location` headers whose host is not the upstream's, so they cannot escape to an attacker-chosen host.
verification: grep $http_host 与 proxy_set_header Host 全部命中点，逐条确认用的是 $host；并核对各处注释里记录的 P2-19 修复说明。

title: Panel init script permanently disables the platform firewall service before validating the replacement ruleset and ignores deploy_mode
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】执行顺序已经倒过来：:197 先 `nft -f "$RULES_FILE"` 装规则，**成功之后** :203 才 `firewall disable`；装载失败时（:208-210 的两条 ERROR）一步都不动 fw4，平台防火墙继续替项目守着。恢复路径（:136-137）也是先 `/etc/init.d/firewall stop` 再 `nft -f .lastgood` 且必须通过 _ruleset_usable 功能性复核才继续。:46-53 的注释把这条顺序变更的理由写清楚了（disable 是**永久**的，规则没装上则下次开机照样裸奔）。
impact: A boot on which the custom ruleset cannot be loaded leaves the router with no firewall at all (WAN input/forward unfiltered) and leaves fw4 disabled for all future boots, so the exposure persists until an operator manually re-enables the service. The condition is invisible: only one line in a log file records it, and both the init script and the panel report success.
mitigation: Do not disable the platform firewall until the replacement ruleset has been validated with the same double check the panel uses (`nft -c -f` plus a functional verification of table inet fw4, as in backend/app.py:9559-9602), and re-enable it (`/etc/init.d/firewall enable`) whenever the replacement chain fails. Gate the stop/disable on deploy_mode == openwrt (read from the panel config) and skip it entirely in linux_gateway mode. Abort the start with a non-zero exit when no ruleset could be installed, instead of only logging the failure.
verification: 读 backend/nftables-web.init:40-60 的设计说明与 :130-215 的执行段，确认 disable 出现在 nft -f 成功分支内、失败分支不触碰 fw4。

title: Timing/state-enumeration oracle on POST /auth/login: dummy PBKDF2 path uses 100000 iterations while the deployed hash uses 200000
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】dummy 路径的 PBKDF2 迭代数现在取 `max(存储哈希里的真实 iters, PBKDF2_ITERATIONS_MIN(100000), PBKDF2_ITERATIONS_DUMMY(200000))`（:463）⇒ dummy 路径**永远不慢于**真实路径，「未设口令比设了口令慢/快」这个时间差被消掉。PBKDF2_ITERATIONS_DUMMY=200000（:137）刻意对齐面板侧的真实默认值。另有 _probe_pbkdf2_parallelism()（:162）处理「pbkdf2_hmac 在某些 Python 版本会释放 GIL ⇒ 并发下时序被抹平」的问题，保证比较在受控条件下进行。
impact: Unauthenticated state enumeration: a single POST /auth/login with {"password":"x"} and response-latency measurement distinguishes "this deployment has a password configured" from "the password file is missing/unreadable/malformed" (and leaks the configured iteration count). This tells an attacker whether brute-forcing the live credential is worthwhile, exposes the degraded state in which every login attempt silently fails, and contradicts the module's explicit anti-enumeration contract.
mitigation: Make both branches perform the same amount of work. Concretely: (a) parse the iteration count out of the stored hash before the validity checks and use it for the dummy KDF as well, so the malformed-hash case costs the same as the configured case; (b) when the stored value cannot be parsed at all, use the *production* iteration count (200000, matching backend/app.py:14) instead of `PBKDF2_ITERATIONS_MIN`; (c) keep the dummy KDF inside `PBKDF2_GATE` (already done) and add a unit test that asserts the two branches take statistically indistinguishable time. Ideally share one constant between the panel and the gateway so the minimum and the production count cannot drift apart again.
verification: 读 auth_gateway.py:120-200 的常量与探针实现、:430-470 的校验分支，确认 dummy_iters 的 max() 取值与注释里记录的 Shannon finding 修复。

title: Gateway login form can fall back to a GET submission, placing the plaintext password in the URL, browser history and server access log
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】登录表单显式写了 method="post"（:61 `<form class="pw-form" id="form" method="post" autocomplete="on" novalidate>`），:51 的注释专门说明「必须写 method="post"：不写默认是 GET，密码会进 URL」。⇒ 明文口令不会落进 URL / 浏览器历史 / Referer。
impact: A user's gateway password can end up in a URL instead of a request body whenever the page's submit handler is not active (script asset failure, or scripting disabled). The credential is then persisted in the browser history/session store, displayed in the address bar, and recorded verbatim in the nginx access log. Anyone able to read that log or the shared browser profile obtains the administrative password for the public edge — the same password that guards every `public_access=true` reverse-proxied service.
mitigation: Make the form safe by construction instead of relying on script: give it `method="post"` and `action="/auth/login"` so that, if the JavaScript handler is missing, the browser still sends the password in a request body rather than in the URL (the gateway's GET route can then answer 405, or a dedicated non-JS POST endpoint can be added). Additionally, remove the `name="password"` attribute from the input (or use `formaction`/`method` explicitly) so no native submission can ever serialise the secret into a query string, and add a `noscript` warning that states the page requires JavaScript. As defence in depth, configure nginx not to log query strings for the `/auth/login` location (`access_log ... "..."` with `$uri` instead of `$request_uri`).
verification: 读 backend/static/login.html:45-65 的表单定义与注释。

title: Panel source-address boundary fails open (no restriction) when the configuration file is missing or corrupt
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：已修】_panel_allowed_networks() 现在是 **fail-closed**：配置缺失/损坏/读不出来时返回 _DENY_ALL_NETS，拒绝所有来源，而不是「不限制」。源码 :609 的注释写明这是 2026-11-08 P1-26 的修复、且是用户拍板的取舍。判据不止看文件存在——还要再问一次 _config_corrupted()，因为「文件存在但内容是坏的」照样会把管理员锁死。降级期间的代价是面板完全不可达（包括 8443 的 /fw/ 入口），唯一恢复路径是 SSH 修好配置。
impact: The LAN-only access boundary protecting a root-privileged firewall/nginx control plane disappears silently and permanently after the configuration file is deleted, corrupted or restored from an old backup. The panel then accepts connections from any source address, exposing the unauthenticated login/setup endpoints to the internet and, together with a weak or brute-forced password, full root control of the router (nft ruleset, uci, cron, nginx, TLS material).
mitigation: Fail closed. When the config file is missing or corrupted, derive the allowed networks from a source that does not depend on the mutable config (e.g. the detected LAN interface address /24 via `_lan_bind_address`, or an explicit `panel_allowed_nets` stored in a separate, integrity-protected file) and deny everything that is not inside it. If no trustworthy boundary can be derived, refuse to serve the panel (or serve it only on the loopback/LAN address with an explicit, loudly logged "LAN boundary unavailable" mode) instead of returning an empty list that means "allow all". Add the missing-file/corrupt states to the "config lost after setup" guard (`_config_lost_after_setup`, app.py:776) so the safe-mode check is not bypassed, and change the warning wording so the operator knows the condition is permanent, not transient.
verification: 读 backend/app.py:606-646 的 _panel_allowed_networks 全文（含 docstring 里的 三段优先级与降级说明），确认第三档是「拒绝所有来源」而不是「不限制」。

title: acme.sh DNS-01 plugin scripts downloaded over the WAN without checksum/signature and later executed as root by the panel
description: 【2026-11-20 复核（T0 专项）：仍成立】acme.sh 的 DNS-01 插件在安装期从网络下载后，直接被 root 执行，下载与执行之间**没有校验和也没有签名验证**。下载源不可信或被中间人劫持 ⇒ 攻击者可以把任意代码塞进一个以 root 运行的DNS 插件里。缓解事实：CA 端点写死在安装期的 account.conf（setup.sh:1765），面板不能指定；但**插件脚本本身**的下载与校验是缺口。严重度定为 MEDIUM（而非基线的 HIGH）：触发需要证书申请流程 + 下载源被劫持，且插件是按 DNS 提供方选定的固定几个。
mitigation: Download each plugin, verify it against a pinned SHA-256 (or a signature by a key pinned in the repo) for the exact acme.sh release in use, and only then move it into place and chmod +x; abort the plugin install on mismatch instead of continuing with an unverified file.
verification: 子 agent 逐行核过 backend/app.py:12513-12526 的 _acme_issue 与 setup/vendor/acme-dnsapi/ 下的插件；本轮主线程复核了 CA 端点写死这一点（setup.sh:1765），确认请求方无法控制 CA，但插件下载无校验这点成立。

title: detect-* endpoints enforce the LAN-only target policy on the first hop only; the default urllib opener follows cross-host redirects, so the echoed body fragments can come from any reachable host
description:
MECHANISM (verified line by line; no request was executed).

Entry: POST /api/reverse-proxy/detect-api-prefix (backend/app.py:13034) and POST /api/reverse-proxy/detect-protocol-relative (backend/app.py:13071). Both take target_address / target_protocol from the JSON body (backend/app.py:13047-13049 / 13082-13084) and call _detect_target_allowed(host) before probing (backend/app.py:13063 / 13097).

Guard: _detect_target_allowed (backend/app.py:2286) is a genuinely strict LAN-only policy. The host must parse as an IPv4 literal via ipaddress.ip_address(raw) (backend/app.py:2310), IPv6 is rejected (backend/app.py:2313-2314), and the address must fall inside lan_subnet4 or the auto-detected LAN net (backend/app.py:2319-2331). Hostnames, /0 and /1 nets are refused. The baseline wording 'fetch an arbitrary attacker-chosen host:port' therefore no longer holds literally: an arbitrary host IS rejected now.

Defect: the policy is applied to the FIRST HOP ONLY. The probe helpers build f'{proto}://{host}:{port}/openapi.json' (backend/app.py:2349) and f'{proto}://{host}:{port}{path}' (backend/app.py:2412) and fetch them with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) (backend/app.py:2353 / 2416). urlopen uses the process-wide default opener; there is no build_opener / install_opener / HTTPRedirectHandler / ProxyHandler anywhere in backend/ or setup/ (verified by grep). CPython's default HTTPRedirectHandler follows 301/302/303/307/308 for GET with NO re-validation of the target host, and its only scheme restriction is ('http','https','ftp','') - verified against the local CPython 3.13.5 urllib/request.py. A LAN host that answers with a 302 therefore turns the LAN-only fetcher into an arbitrary-host fetcher. The file scheme is blocked by CPython itself; the ftp scheme is not.

Response reflection: the fetched body IS reflected, partially. _detect_upstream_api_prefixes returns the first path segment of every route in the target's openapi.json (backend/app.py:2375-2381). _detect_upstream_protocol_relative returns up to 5 VERBATIM href="//..." / src="//..." / action="//..." strings of up to 120 chars each (backend/app.py:2424-2431). The error paths deliberately return a generic message so the endpoint does not leak connection-refused vs timeout (backend/app.py:2356-2360).

Adjacent asymmetry, recorded but NOT reported as a separate finding because it is design-forced: the same target_address field is validated for FORMAT ONLY on the reverse-proxy rule path (_validate_rp_service, backend/app.py:9968-9995 -> _valid_upstream_host at 11431-11445, _sanitize_target_address at 9826-9853, _host_resolvable at 9781-9823), i.e. 127.0.0.1 and 169.254.169.254 are accepted there. That is the owner configuring their own upstream and there is no unauthenticated path to it, so per the severity rules it is not a finding - it is noted here only because it is the same field and the same class of sink.

REQUIRES AN EXISTING PANEL SESSION: neither route is in the before_request exemption list (backend/app.py:842-847), so _require_auth returns 401 without a valid session (backend/app.py:795-872). Severity is capped at MEDIUM for that reason.
impact: With a panel session, an attacker who controls one LAN host (or finds an open redirector on one) can make the router fetch any host:port reachable from it - including 127.0.0.1 services on the router itself (panel :5443, auth gateway :8444) and cloud-metadata endpoints - and read fragments of the response back through the JSON result (openapi route names, or up to 5 verbatim protocol-relative URLs). The LAN-only policy that exists specifically to prevent this (documented as P2-9 in backend/app.py:2289-2303) is defeated on the redirect hop.
mitigation: Install a dedicated opener in both probe helpers. Either use urllib.request.build_opener() with a HTTPRedirectHandler subclass whose redirect_request re-runs _detect_target_allowed() on the new host and rejects any scheme outside ('http','https') (CPython permits ftp by default), or simply refuse every 30x. Apply it at backend/app.py:2353 and backend/app.py:2416. Additionally re-validate resp.geturl() before parsing the body, and shrink the protocol-relative sample size returned to the caller.
verification: Read backend/app.py:2286-2331 (_detect_target_allowed), 2334-2381 and 2390-2431 (both probe helpers), 13034-13102 (both routes) and 795-872 (the global auth interceptor). Grepped backend/ and setup/ for build_opener / install_opener / HTTPRedirectHandler / ProxyHandler -> no hits, therefore the default opener is used. Read the local CPython 3.13.5 urllib/request.py source for HTTPRedirectHandler.redirect_request and build_opener to confirm cross-host 30x following without host re-validation and the ('http','https','ftp','') scheme allow-list. No request was sent to any device and no repository file was modified.

title: logd remote syslog target accepts any IPv4 literal, including loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses, and forwards the router's firewall logs to it in cleartext
description:
MECHANISM (verified line by line; no request was executed).

Entry: POST /api/logd/config (backend/app.py:7865).

Validation: log_ip is checked ONLY for dotted-quad syntax and octet range: ip_pattern = r'^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$' (backend/app.py:7911) plus the per-octet 0-255 test (backend/app.py:7914-7916). There is no ipaddress-based range check, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, 255.255.255.255, 169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata), 10.x / 172.16-31.x / 192.168.x and multicast addresses are all accepted. The contrast with the port-forward path in the same codebase is explicit: _bad_forward_target (backend/app.py:1618) exists precisely to reject loopback / link-local / metadata targets, and the logd handler never calls it. log_port must be 1-65535 and log_proto must be tcp or udp (backend/app.py:7919-7925).

Sink: the value is written into the OpenWrt system UCI package (system.@system[0].log_ip / log_port / log_proto, backend/app.py:7927-7937) via _uci_set (backend/app.py:6142-6171), committed with uci commit system (backend/app.py:7946), and the log daemon is then restarted with /etc/init.d/log restart (backend/app.py:7950). OpenWrt's logd opens an outbound TCP/UDP syslog connection to that destination and forwards every kernel log message - including every nftables log hit, which carries the offending source IP - over PLAINTEXT with no authentication or integrity protection.

Side effect: restarting logd clears the local in-memory ring buffer, which the developers themselves document at backend/app.py:7869-7872 and surface to the UI at 7959. The same request can therefore erase local forensic history while exporting it elsewhere.

REQUIRES AN EXISTING PANEL SESSION: /api/logd/config is not exempt in before_request (backend/app.py:842-847), so _require_auth returns 401 without a valid session (backend/app.py:795-872). Severity is capped at MEDIUM for that reason.
impact: With a panel session, an attacker can point the router's syslog forwarding at any IPv4 address of their choosing. Kernel firewall logs (source IPs of scan attempts and of accepted connections) and gateway authentication syslog are then delivered in cleartext to that third party. With log_proto=tcp the router also opens a persistent outbound TCP connection to an arbitrary IP:port, giving a connection oracle into internal services and into 169.254.169.254 on a cloud-hosted deployment.
mitigation: In the handler at backend/app.py:7910-7916, parse log_ip with ipaddress.ip_address() and reject loopback, link-local (169.254.0.0/16, which covers the 169.254.169.254 metadata address), unspecified (0.0.0.0), broadcast (255.255.255.255), multicast and the private ranges - reuse the existing _bad_forward_target policy (backend/app.py:1618) so both paths share one rule set. Keep the operator able to opt in explicitly, and require confirmation for the buffer-clearing side effect before restarting logd.
verification: Read backend/app.py:7865-7969 (the whole handler), 7910-7916 (the only validation applied to log_ip), 7919-7925 (port/proto validation), 7927-7937 (UCI write), 7946-7950 (commit + logd restart), 6142-6171 (_uci_set) and 1618 onward (_bad_forward_target, for contrast). Grepped the handler for ipaddress usage -> none. No request was sent and no repository file was modified.

title: DDNS service fields other than ipv6_source (service_name, domain, param_opt, check_interval, ...) reach the UCI ddns store verbatim with only CR/LF stripped
impact: If ddns-scripts evaluates the stored option values as shell, an administrator-session holder (or anyone who steals that session) can persist an arbitrary root command into /etc/config/ddns that executes on the next DDNS update cycle and survives reboots. Unconfirmed pending inspection of the ddns-scripts package itself.
mitigation: Apply the same allow-list treatment that ipv6_source received (backend/app.py:6245-6248): validate service_name against the installed provider list computed at backend/app.py:6192-6204, allow-list ip_source / ip_network / interface against known enums, force check_interval to an integer in a sane range, and drop param_enc / param_opt entirely unless a concrete need exists. As defence in depth, reject any value containing shell metacharacters before writing it into any UCI option that a shell may later evaluate.
verification: Read backend/app.py:6142-6171 (_uci_set), 6226-6249 (_validate_ddns_services), 6314-6522 (save_ddns_config, every field write at 6398-6499) and 6192-6204 (provider listing). Grepped the whole repository for 'param_opt|param_enc' and for 'ip_script' to locate every consumer: the only in-repo consumer of the UCI ddns package is the panel's own Aliyun script generator _generate_ddns_update_script (backend/app.py:6606 onward), which is pure Python, reads a separate JSON config and contains no eval and no subprocess - it never reads /etc/config/ddns, so it is not a sink. The ddns-scripts package is not vendored in this repository, so the final root-eval step could not be verified. No request was sent and no file was modified.

title: Unfiltered DNS credential values are injected into the root acme.sh child process environment and persisted by the plugin into acme.sh's account store
description:
MECHANISM (verified line by line; no request was executed).

Entry: POST /api/reverse-proxy/certificates/request (backend/app.py:13784) -> _acme_issue (backend/app.py:12466). The request's dns_credentials object is passed straight through (backend/app.py:13825) and the child environment is built at backend/app.py:12514-12516:

    env = os.environ.copy()
    for field in provider["fields"]:
        env[field["key"]] = creds[field["key"]]

No filtering of any kind is applied to the credential VALUES - no length cap, no charset check, no rejection of quotes, dollar signs, backticks or newlines. The same pattern is used by the renew path _acme_renew (backend/app.py:12580-12583). The acme.sh child runs as root (the panel is root), and the vendored plugins persist the values straight into acme.sh's account store: _saveaccountconf_mutable CF_Token "$CF_Token" (setup/vendor/acme-dnsapi/dns_cf.sh:36), _saveaccountconf_mutable Ali_Key "$Ali_Key" and Ali_Secret (dns_ali.sh:64-65), GD_Key / GD_Secret (dns_gd.sh:31-32), PORKBUN_API_KEY / PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY (dns_porkbun.sh:33-34), Tencent_SecretId / Tencent_SecretKey (dns_tencent.sh:28-29).

WHAT IS NOT TRUE - adjudicated, do not re-report these as SSRF:
  - The DNS provider is a fixed allow-list. dns_provider is rejected unless it is a key of DNS_PROVIDERS (backend/app.py:13805-13807; the table is backend/app.py:10153-10230) and provider["acme_param"] - the plugin name - comes from that table, never from the request.
  - The CA endpoint is NOT request-controllable. Grepping the whole repository for '--server|DEFAULT_ACME_SERVER|acme-v02' finds only setup/setup.sh:60 and 1765 plus test files - there is no --server argument anywhere in backend/. The CA URL is written once at install time into acme.sh's account.conf as DEFAULT_ACME_SERVER (setup/setup.sh:1763-1766).
  - The environment KEYS are fixed per provider. env[field["key"]] iterates over the STATIC provider["fields"] list, so a request cannot inject an arbitrary environment variable name - it can only overwrite the value of a declared field.
  - The domain is constrained by _sanitize_cert_domain to a strict FQDN regex (backend/app.py:9500-9521), so it is not injectable.

WHY THIS IS UNCERTAIN AND NOT CONFIRMED: the final step - whether acme.sh re-parses the persisted account.conf with eval, which would let a quote in the credential break out of the stored value - lives in the acme.sh main script, which is NOT vendored in this repository, and network access was not permitted. In the vendored plugin code the values only appear in quoted expansions or as pipeline arguments (e.g. token_trimmed=$(echo "$CF_Token" | tr -d '"') at dns_cf.sh:231; query=$query'AccessKeyId='$Ali_Key at dns_ali.sh:162), which are safe from shell injection but do show the value reaching a URL / parameter string.

REQUIRES AN EXISTING PANEL SESSION: the endpoint is not exempt in before_request (backend/app.py:842-847), so _require_auth returns 401 without a valid session (backend/app.py:795-872).
impact: Unverified. If acme.sh re-parses the persisted account.conf with eval, an administrator-session holder could persist arbitrary root shell code on the router through a crafted DNS credential value, and the payload would be re-executed on later renewals. If acme.sh stores the value safely, the impact is limited to malformed API requests that fail the ACME flow and the credential ending up in a root-owned config file.
mitigation: Filter the credential values before they enter the child environment, at backend/app.py:12515-12516 and backend/app.py:12581-12583: restrict each provider field to the charset that provider actually accepts (API keys, tokens and secrets are alphanumerics plus a few punctuation characters), cap the length, and reject values containing quotes, backslashes, dollar signs, backticks, newlines or NUL. Independently, verify against the pinned acme.sh release whether account.conf is eval-parsed; if it is, the filter above becomes mandatory rather than advisory.
verification: Read backend/app.py:12466-12540 (_acme_issue), 12568-12627 (_acme_renew), 13784-13846 (rp_request_cert), 10153-10230 (DNS_PROVIDERS) and 9500-9521 (_sanitize_cert_domain). Grepped the whole repository for '--server|DEFAULT_ACME_SERVER|acme-v02' and read all six vendored plugins in setup/vendor/acme-dnsapi/. Grepped backend/ and setup/ for build_opener / install_opener -> none. The acme.sh main script is not present in the repository, so the account.conf parse step could not be verified. No request was sent and no file was modified.

title: acme.sh DNS-01 plugin network-download fallback still has no checksum or signature and the downloaded plugin is later executed as root by the panel
description:
The baseline finding 'acme.sh DNS-01 plugin scripts downloaded over the WAN without checksum/signature and later executed as root by the panel' is PARTIALLY fixed, and the residual is confirmed.

What is fixed: the primary install path now copies a vendored, in-repository copy - cp "${vendor_dnsapi}/${p}.sh" "${dnsapi_dir}/${p}.sh" && chmod +x (setup/setup.sh:1679-1684) - so a normal install from the shipped package no longer touches the network at all. setup/vendor/acme-dnsapi/ contains all six plugins (dns_ali.sh, dns_cf.sh, dns_gd.sh, dns_huaweicloud.sh, dns_porkbun.sh, dns_tencent.sh).

What is NOT fixed: the network fallback is still present and still unverified. curl -4 -fsSL --connect-timeout 10 --retry 1 --max-time 30 -o "${dnsapi_dir}/${p}.sh.part" "${base}/${p}.sh" (setup/setup.sh:1719-1720) pulls from gitee.com and raw.githubusercontent.com (setup/setup.sh:1700). The ONLY check applied to the downloaded file is that it is non-empty and its first line starts with a shebang (setup/setup.sh:1725). The file is then moved into place and made executable (setup/setup.sh:1726-1727), after which the panel runs it as root: subprocess.run([acme_sh, '--issue', '--dns', provider['acme_param'], '-d', domain], ..., env=env, timeout=300) (backend/app.py:12524-12527).

Residual condition: the operator installed from setup.sh alone (no vendor/acme-dnsapi/ directory) AND the download path was hijacked or the upstream account/CDN was compromised.

This is install-time only and is never triggered by a request, so it is not remotely exploitable on its own.
impact: An attacker who can position themselves on the device's download path (DNS/ARP spoofing towards the download hosts, a compromised CDN or upstream account, or a malicious mirror) obtains root code execution on the router at install time. Exposure is materially reduced versus the baseline because the vendored copy is now the primary path and the fallback only engages when the vendor directory is absent.
mitigation: Pin the fallback downloads to a SHA-256 of the exact acme.sh release in use - the same technique the project already applies to the china-ips list (backend/app.py:5810-5888) - verify the digest before the mv into the plugin directory, and abort the plugin install on mismatch. Failing that, remove the network fallback entirely and require the vendored directory to be present, failing the install with a clear message.
verification: Read setup/setup.sh:1620-1740 (install_dns_plugins), confirmed the vendored branch at 1679-1684 and the curl fallback at 1719-1727, and listed setup/vendor/acme-dnsapi/ (6 plugins present in-repo). Read backend/app.py:12524-12527 for the root execution of the plugin. No download was attempted, no request was sent and no file was modified.

title: Unvalidated DDNS `ipv6_source` is interpolated into the root-evaluated `ip_script` shell command (root command injection)
description:
STATUS: FIXED in the current source (commit 68d7bd6, 2026-10-29, 'fix(security): Shannon 渗透测试 11 条 P0 修复（v0.8.7）'). Kept in the list so the reconciliation can confirm that the baseline entry is closed.

The original mechanism: ipv6_source was concatenated into ip_script ('/bin/cat /tmp/ddns-ipv6-<value>'), and ip_script is evaluated as a root command by OpenWrt's ddns-scripts. The developers' own comment records an empirically confirmed exploit on device .233: a value of 'x;id' produced ip_script = /bin/cat /tmp/ddns-ipv6-x;id (backend/app.py:6448-6454).

The fix is two-layered and BOTH layers are present today.
  Layer 1 - pre-validation before any UCI mutation: _validate_ddns_services (backend/app.py:6226) rejects any ipv6_source that is neither 'router' nor a full match of rule_\d+ (backend/app.py:6245-6248). It is called at backend/app.py:6324, i.e. BEFORE the existing service sections are deleted (backend/app.py:6380-6381), so a rejected request cannot leave a half-written config behind.
  Layer 2 - the assembly site re-derives the index from the whitelist instead of from the raw string: _src = str(ipv6_source) (backend/app.py:6457); 'router' maps to idx '0' (backend/app.py:6458-6459); otherwise _re.fullmatch(r'rule_(\d+)', _src) and idx = _m.group(1) (backend/app.py:6461-6469), with an explicit refusal path that skips the IPv6 configuration instead of concatenating (backend/app.py:6470-6472). ip_script is then built from the server-side constant path _ddns_relay_path(idx) (backend/app.py:6480-6481), never from user input.

SEVERITY CORRECTION: the baseline rated this CRITICAL with privileges_required NONE. That rating is NOT supported by the current source. POST /api/ddns/save is not in the before_request exemption list (backend/app.py:842-847) and _require_auth returns 401 without a valid panel session (backend/app.py:795-872). The global auth interceptor was added in commit 5aa8ed6 (2026-09-13, 'v0.7.9: 安全加固'), well before the 2026-10-29 baseline, so the endpoint has always required an administrator session. Because the panel itself runs as root, this is a defence-in-depth / blast-radius issue rather than a privilege-boundary crossing - MEDIUM, not CRITICAL, under the severity table used for this round.

Sibling fields are NOT fixed - see the separate entry on service_name / param_opt / domain / check_interval reaching the UCI store verbatim.
impact: None in the current code for this vector. Historically, an administrator-session holder could persist an arbitrary root command into /etc/config/ddns that executed on the next DDNS update cycle.
mitigation: Already fixed in two layers (backend/app.py:6245-6248 and backend/app.py:6457-6481). Keep both layers, and add a regression test asserting that a rejected ipv6_source leaves the existing UCI ddns sections untouched - the ordering of validation before deletion is load-bearing and easy to break.
